Travel Itinerary Generator with AI
Description
The "Travel Itinerary Generator with AI" is a personal travel planner application that uses AI to create custom, logically ordered travel itineraries, based on user's preferences.
Table of Contents
User Experience


Business Goals


Target Audience


Key Features


Technical Requirements


Design and UX


Marketing and Monetization


Success Metrics


Authentication & Accounts


User Flows


User Experience
Users can use this app to plan their trips effortlessly and save time. The generated itineraries can be edited and saved, and actions like booking hotels or tickets can be taken right from the app. The app's plan collaboration feature allows users to plan trips with friends or family in a seamless manner.
Accounts & Access (added):
Users see clear “Entrar” and “Criar conta” buttons.


Logged-in users have a Dashboard with all saved itineraries.


Guest users can browse the app, but when requesting a personalized itinerary they are prompted to create an account / login to view and save the generated plan.


After authentication, the requested itinerary is created, stored under the user’s account, and displayed.


Business Goals
Provide users with an optimized and personalized trip platform


Generate revenue through premium subscriptions and affiliates


Be a leading brand in the travel tech industry within 2 years


Target Audience
Independent couples in their late twenties or early thirties who are tech-savvy and value authentic experiences, good food, and optimised itineraries.


Families with kids planning their school vacation who need a balance between their interests, include activities for youngsters, are safe and help control the budget.


Budget-conscious, solo or backpacker travelers looking for cheaper options and free activities.


Key Features
Travel planner with AI: Use AI to generate optimized, day-to-day travel plans based on user's budget, preferences, and travel dates.


Interactive map with routes: Integration with Google Maps or Mapbox for location tracking and optimized route drawing.


Collaboration: Allow users to invite friends/family to edit the trip plan in real time.


Budget Estimation: Based on chosen budget level, calculate an estimated daily cost including tickets, average food and transportation expenses.


Integration with booking platforms: Integration with platforms such as GetYourGuide, Civitatis, Tiqets, Booking.com, TheFork, etc for booking tickets and hotels.


Offline Mode: Allow users to download the itinerary and map to access them without the internet.


Dashboard: Logged in area with visual cards of all users' saved travels. Each card features a photo of the destination and the dates.


Authentication & Accounts (added): Email/senha e OAuth (Google/Apple). Armazenar com segurança o perfil do usuário e seus roteiros.


Saved Itineraries (added): Todo roteiro criado por usuário logado é salvo e pode ser duplicado, editado, exportado (PDF/CSV) e compartilhado.


Guest Gating (added): Usuários sem conta são informados que precisam criar conta/entrar para ver o roteiro personalizado solicitado.


Technical Requirements
Integrated with Google Maps/Mapbox.


Affiliates: Integration with booking platforms.


Backend: Able to handle a high volume of requests and users at the same time.


Frontend: Responsive design.


Security: Compliant with GDPR and other privacy policies. Protected against breaches.


Authentication & Data (added):
OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect (Google/Apple) + email/senha.


Sessions via JWT/secure cookies; refresh tokens; logout seguro.


Tables: users, itineraries, itinerary_collaborators, destinations, days, activities. Row-Level Security por user_id.


LGPD/GDPR: consentimento, política de privacidade, exclusão de conta e portabilidade de dados.


Rate limiting no endpoint de geração para evitar abuso.


Auditoria mínima: created_at/updated_at/last_login.


Design and UX
Logo: A design that inspires exploration and intelligence. Could be a paper plane following a dotted line, or a fusion of a map pin (location) with a brain/neural network icon (AI).


Typography: Clear functional fonts like Playfair Display, Gilroy, Inter, and Source Sans Pro.


Colors: Primary color deep blue (#005A8D), Accent color Coral (#FF6B6B) or sun-yellow (#FFD166), Secondary color earth tones and neutrals (beige, light grey).


Auth UI (added):
Header com botões: “Entrar” (outline) e “Criar conta” (filled).


CTA principal em páginas de geração: “Gerar roteiro”. Se não logado, abrir modal:


Título: “Crie sua conta para ver seu roteiro”


Texto: “Em menos de 1 minuto, você salva e acessa seu roteiro personalizado.”


Botões: “Criar conta”, “Entrar”, “Continuar com Google”, “Continuar com Apple”


Toasts PT-BR:


Sucesso login: “Bem-vindo, {nome}!”


Roteiro salvo: “Roteiro salvo no seu painel.”


Erro genérico: “Algo deu errado. Tente novamente.”


Marketing and Monetization
Freemuim model


Affiliate marketing


In-app purchases and premium subscription


Auth impact (added):
Captação via geração de roteiro: o bloqueio para convidados aumenta cadastro qualificado.


E-mails transacionais: “Seu roteiro está pronto” (após criar conta).


Success Metrics
Active users: Number of users who have generated at least one itinerary in the last month.


Conversion Rate: The percentage of users who purchased a premium subscription.


User reviews and ratings: High app store ratings and positive user feedback.


Revenue growth: Increase in monthly revenue from subscriptions and affiliates commissions.


Auth KPIs (added):
Taxa de cadastro após tentativa de gerar roteiro (guest → signup).


% de roteiros salvos por usuário logado.


Retenção 30 dias de usuários com ≥1 roteiro salvo.


Authentication and Accounts
Login/Signup: oferecer email/senha e OAuth (Google/Apple).


Armazenamento: todo roteiro é vinculado ao user_id.


Bloqueio para convidados: quando um convidado clicar em “Gerar roteiro personalizado”, exibir modal de criação de conta. O roteiro só é exibido após login/criação de conta.


Dashboard: listar cartões com foto do destino, período e status; ações: abrir, duplicar, editar, exportar, excluir.


Colaboração: convites por e-mail; se o convidado não tiver conta, deve criar para visualizar/editar.


Privacidade: LGPD/GDPR; exclusão de conta remove dados do usuário (ou anonimiza conforme política).


User Flows
Guest → Generate:


Clica “Gerar roteiro”. Abrir modal de conta.


Ao se cadastrar/logar, gerar roteiro, salvar e redirecionar para a página do roteiro.


Logged-in → Generate:


Gera e salva automaticamente no Dashboard; feedback de sucesso.


View/Edit:


Edição em tempo real; autosave a cada X segundos.


Collab:


Dono envia convite; colaborador aceita → se necessário, cria conta → recebe acesso conforme permissão (ver/editar).


Access Control:


Qualquer link de roteiro exige autenticação; se não logado, redirecionar para login e, após sucesso, retornar ao roteiro.


Observação final:
 Todos os textos, rótulos, mensagens, exemplos, descrições e conteúdos gerados para este produto devem ser escritos exclusivamente em português do Brasil, utilizando as melhores práticas de comunicação, design e usabilidade para o público brasileiro. Isso inclui adaptação cultural, vocabulário adequado, formatação numérica e monetária conforme padrões brasileiros (ex.: R$ 1.500,00), além de referências e exemplos relevantes ao contexto nacional.

**Initializing the Project**

I'm starting by carefully analyzing the request. The core concept is clear: a React web app for generating personalized travel itineraries.  I've already come up with a potential name, "ViajaIA," for the app's metadata. My next step is to break down the user stories and desired features.


**Defining Core Functionality**

I'm now nailing down the key features. The focus is on a user-friendly React app in Portuguese for the Brazilian market. The essential elements are a compelling landing page with a clear call-to-action, a preference form, and a Gemini-powered itinerary generator. A crucial detail: users need to log in before generating itineraries. I'm thinking of simulating this authorization with local state. My priority now is a well-structured tech stack with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind, and I'm planning a professional folder architecture.


**Refining the Backend Mock**

I've decided to simulate the backend with an `AuthContext`, handling login/logout with local storage. This will store user data for the demo. I've also defined an itinerary interface, breaking it down into days, activities, and associated costs. Routing will be handled with `HashRouter`, as specified, and I'm setting up a `geminiService.ts` for calls to the Gemini API via `@google/genai`.


**Defining UI Elements**

I've been creating essential UI components, including a reusable Tailwind button (`Button.tsx`), the landing page (`Home.tsx`) with the input form, and the all-important authentication modal (`AuthModal.tsx`). I'm also working on the dashboard (`Dashboard.tsx`) for saved trips and the itinerary details view (`ItineraryDetails.tsx`) with a timeline, map placeholder, and budget display.


**Building the Core Logic**

I'm now streamlining the user flow after "login."  The plan is to trigger the AI call with the form data, save the itinerary to local storage, and then redirect to the itinerary page.  I'm using the `GoogleGenAI` library with the API key and I'm implementing a `responseSchema` for JSON output.  I've decided to move the AI call until *after* modal closure for a smoother experience.


**Incorporating Visuals & Navigation**

I'm now refining the UI, implementing a budget breakdown chart using `recharts` in the itinerary details. I've also incorporated a navigation structure using `HashRouter` to handle routing without `react-router-dom`. The project structure is fully fleshed out, including metadata and all files like `geminiService.ts`, `AuthContext.tsx`, and component files. Everything is styled entirely with Tailwind, and ready for deployment.


**Presenting the Itinerary**

I've finally brought the `ItineraryDetails.tsx` component into shape. It's now beautifully displaying the itinerary data, with a nice chart thanks to `recharts`. The final stage is just around the corner - I'm almost ready to wrap everything together, creating the final product.

Este arquivo cria o contexto de notificações. Ele gerencia o estado dos alertas (sucesso/erro) e renderiza o container visual no canto da tela.

Adiciona o `<ToastProvider>` ao redor da aplicação. Isso corrige o erro de tela branca, pois agora os componentes filhos podem acessar a função `addToast`.
